en.t: The lady said again, "Why must it be like this?

units.source_text: 就算他有多么了不起，我的女儿初次结婚，难道嫁个流放犯不成？

en.t: No matter how remarkable he may be, this is my daughter's first marriage; how could she possibly marry an exile?

units.source_text: 假定对方有心爱她，还可说说。

en.t: If he truly intended to love her, there might still be something to discuss.

units.source_text: 但他根本就不会爱我女儿的。”

en.t: But he simply will not love my daughter at all."

units.source_text: 明石道人更加冒火了，驳道：“获罪谪戍，在中国，在我国朝廷，都是常有的事。

en.t: The Akashi monk grew even angrier and retorted, "To be punished and sent into exile is common, both in China and at our own court.

units.source_text: 凡是英明俊杰、迥异凡俗的人，必然难免谪戍。

en.t: Any brilliant and outstanding person, anyone far removed from the ordinary, is bound to face exile sooner or later.

units.source_text: 你知道源氏公子是怎样的人？

en.t: Do you know what kind of man Prince Genji is?

units.source_text: 他已故的母后桐壶妃子，是我已故叔父按察大纳言的女儿。

en.t: His late mother, the Kiritsubo Consort, was the daughter of my late uncle, the Azechi Grand Counselor.

units.source_text: 这位妃子的美貌，闻名于世。

en.t: This consort's beauty was renowned throughout the world.

units.source_text: 入宫之后，蒙桐壶帝特别宠爱，身为后宫第一。

en.t: After entering the palace, she received Emperor Kiritsubo's special favor and became first among the women of the court.

units.source_text: 只为众人嫉妒，以致忧恼成疾，短命而死。

en.t: But because everyone envied her, grief and anxiety made her ill, and she died young.

units.source_text: 但能留下这位俊杰的公子，亦不幸中之大幸。

en.t: Yet her leaving behind such an exceptional prince was a great blessing amid misfortune.

units.source_text: 为女子的，第一志气要高。

en.t: For a woman, the first thing is to have high aspirations.

units.source_text: 我虽然是乡下人，但和公子有上述的因缘，想他决不会唾弃我。”

en.t: Although I am a country man, I have the connection with the prince I have just described, so I believe he would never cast me aside."
